claims.promise: A coach can record a hitter or select the hitter's and reference clips locally, so analysis begins with the footage already on the phone instead of a cloud account.

evidence.finding: The measured baseball query has 28 of 30 visibly on-job cards, while the 10K+ Blast Baseball critical sample reports videos failing to upload to its cloud.

claims.deferredReason: Camera capture and the system visual-media picker do not exist until the slot is built.

claims.promise: A coach can scrub a hitter and reference swing frame by frame, use slow motion, overlay a ghosted reference, and draw arrows or angle lines on the decisive frame.

comparison.limitation: Its 100K+ Android critical sample says drawing lines work while drag-and-form angles available on Apple cannot be generated.

evidence.finding: OnForm is measured at 3.0 stars and 100K+ installs; one of its three sampled critical reviews explicitly says Android cannot generate angles.

claims.deferredReason: The player, frame index, overlay renderer, measurement UI, and annotation canvas are unbuilt.

claims.promise: The coach exports a marked still, GIF, or rendered clip through Android share so the player receives the actual correction rather than a separate notification.

comparison.limitation: Its sampled critical review says Share never works and files must be moved and communicated separately.

evidence.finding: A sampled 2-star OnForm review says Share never works; the baseball pocket has 5 paywall complaints among 12 critical reviews.

claims.deferredReason: The renderer, FileProvider, and ACTION_SEND handoff do not exist until the slot is built.

claims.promise: The paid tool is a single permanent unlock and keeps clips and annotations on-device, so video review is not held behind a recurring plan or cloud outage.

evidence.finding: Seven of the eight enriched baseball cards declare in-app purchases, and 5 of 12 critical pocket reviews are classified paywall.

claims.deferredReason: Billing, local-only storage, and the no-account policy are not implemented.
